name: Axera Semiconductor Co., Ltd.
summary: Axera Semiconductor Co., Ltd., established in Ningbo, China, in 2019, offers chip solutions for AI perception and edge computing, with customers in the mainland, Hong Kong, Indonesia, South Korea and Australia. Its products include on-device computing chips such as visual perception SoCs, and smart vehicle SoCs from the M55H, M57 and M76H lines.
